description: 1 double bedroom, 1 bathroom with bathtub, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment — windows on left and right facade(s). Kitchen is adjacent to a window — well-lit cooking position. 1 double bedroom (no walk-in wardrobe, no en-suite), 0 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: single-wall, no island. Cook faces the dining and living area directly — suited to cooking while entertaining or supervising children. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Bathroom config: 1 bathroom(s) with bathtub. Single bathroom — sequential morning routine. Largest bedroom at far end of apartment from living area — maximum privacy and acoustic separation from household activity. Path to kitchen passes through full corridor length. Storage room adjacent to kitchen — usable as kitchen pantry, laundry room or general storage. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is long corridor, living area is short corridor. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits: singles or couples, households prioritising communal cooking and dining.
